items.summary: Workday (NasdaqGS:WDAY) has appointed Sarah Kennedy Ellis as Chief Marketing Officer, effective immediately. items.title: There Is One Thing ASML’s $400 Million Machine Still Cannot Do. AI Chips Keep Making It Worse.
items.summary: ASML's $400 million lithography machine powers every cutting-edge AI chip on the planet, yet one stubborn physical constraint keeps chipmakers stitching together workarounds that quietly erode margins. The fix exists on paper, but the timeline creates a problem no one in the AI supply chain wants to talk about.
